upstream.note: The MoMo developer portal is Azure API Management; its anonymous data API publishes every API's operations and schema document as JSON, but its export endpoint returns the four APIs with empty paths. The machine description is therefore captured per API: the operations listing (upstream-<api>-operations.json, from /developer/apis/<api>/operations) and the OpenAPI components / Swagger definitions document (upstream-<api>-schemas.json, from /developer/apis/<api>/schemas/<id>), each verbatim and hashed in attempts[]. The 56 per-operation detail documents (/developer/apis/<api>/operations/<operationId>?api-version=2022-04-01-preview) were fetched too; the concatenation of their bodies in sorted <api>.<operationId> order hashed to sha256:37bfa7b87503dc78e4d5617f41e9725eb0fe445334ff0db36221430a8a3fb6a3. No single upstream.<ext>/contentHash is recorded because no single upstream file is the whole API (same approach as openlmis).

notes: MTN MoMo Open API (Collection, Disbursement, Remittance, Sandbox User Provisioning) as published on the MTN MoMo developer portal, an Azure API Management instance whose anonymous data API serves every operation and schema as JSON. openapi.json is a mechanical conversion of all 56 published operations (23 + 16 + 14 + 3) and their schema documents into one OpenAPI 3.0.3 document, with each product mounted under its gateway path prefix (/collection, /disbursement, /remittance; sandbox provisioning at the root), which is how the adaptor's request() paths are written. Conversion choices: APIM's misuse of response contentType as an example label ('ReferenceId already in use') became named application/json examples; untyped 202/201 acknowledgements stay bodiless (the API returns no body); four gaps were filled from the same API's own schema document (ValidateAccountHolderStatus 200 -> BooleanResult, GET apiuser 200 -> ApiUserResult, bc-authorize and oauth2/token form bodies -> bcauthorize / oauth2TokenRequest); schemas shared across products were merged (BasicUserInfo and ErrorReason as unions, dropping the remittance enum typo 'TRANSACTION_CANCELED.'); GetInvoiceStatus's {x-referenceId} was renamed {referenceId} to avoid an illegal duplicate templated path; MSISDN-like partyId example values were replaced with 0000000000. Two remittance operations are portal test clones (a /clone-671b0/ prefix and literal 999 padding round the MSISDN) and are kept but marked deprecated. Vendor quirks kept as published: PaymentServerUrl/TargetEnvironment schemas in sandbox provisioning carry an 'apiKey' property, and several example values are numbers where the schema says string. Production host proxy.momoapi.mtn.com comes from MTN's developer community go-live guidance, not from the APIM definitions (which name the sandbox host). Adaptor check: request() only, plus POST /collection/token/ for the token; both ast.json examples (GET /collection/v1_0/accountholder/MSISDN/{id}/basicuserinfo, POST /collection/v2_0/invoice) match.
